title: Issue #207: [P1] Demonstrate a persistent multi-node ATC compute worker path
content:
State: open

## Goal
Demonstrate real distributed worker execution rather than only an in-process scheduler/agent abstraction.

## Scope
Implement or integrate persistent queueing, authenticated worker registration, leases, heartbeats, retries, cancellation and worker-loss recovery using the normative job contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least two independently operated worker processes/nodes register with authenticated identities.
- [ ] A job is persisted, leased to a worker and correlated by task_id/run_id/node_id.
- [ ] Heartbeat expiry, worker crash, retry and recovery reach defined terminal states.
- [ ] Duplicate, stale-lease and late results cannot cause duplicate settlement.
- [ ] A repeatable integration test demonstrates job execution across the independent workers.
- [ ] Logs/results include exact repository SHAs and test-run evidence.

## Dependencies
Normative contracts; durable Aurora identity/task lifecycle.

## Non-claim
Two local agents or two in-process workers are not sufficient evidence of independent multi-node execution.
